elapsed.measurement_note: agent-phase wall clock was not instrumented; only the deterministic extractor and gate calls were timed

resource.rss_measurement: process.memoryUsage().rss at end of the extractor run only (end-of-run, not peak)

instrumentation_not_available.note: per-run provider counters are not exposed in this environment; no estimate was substituted for them

execution_mode.actors: writer, evidence auditor, coverage sentinel and gatekeeper ran as separate agent processes with distinct actor ids

known_limitations: gold annotations were reviewed and approved by a single reviewer, not the two-reviewer resolution described in GOLD_DATASET.md
the deterministic gate validated 179 of 200 citations because fenced code blocks desynchronize its citation scan; see FINDING-gate-citation-undercount.md
agent-phase elapsed time and peak RSS were not instrumented
